# 2 Chronicles 3 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 3 (17 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.2
- **EMET:** "And-he-began to-build in-the-second in-the-month the-second in-year four-of his-reign."
- **LOGOS:** "He began to build in the second month of the fourth year of his reign."
- **PNEUMA:** "Construction began in the second month of the fourth year of Solomon's reign."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.3
- **EMET:** "And-these are-the-foundations-of Solomon for-building house-of God the-length in-cubits by-the-measure the-first cubits sixty and-the-width cubits twe"
- **LOGOS:** "These are the foundations that Solomon laid for building the house of God: the length, in cubits of the old standard, was sixty cubits, and the width "
- **PNEUMA:** "These are the dimensions Solomon used for the foundation of God's temple (using the old standard of measurement): sixty cubits long and twenty cubits "
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.4
- **EMET:** "And-the-porch that was-on the-face-of the-length on the-face-of the-width-of the-house cubits twenty and-the-height a-hundred-and-twenty and-he-overla"
- **LOGOS:** "The vestibule in front of the house was twenty cubits long, equal to the width of the house, and its height was one hundred and twenty cubits. He over"
- **PNEUMA:** "The entry portico across the front of the temple was twenty cubits wide (matching the temple's width) and — according to the text — one hundred twenty"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.7
- **EMET:** "And-he-overlaid the-house the-beams the-thresholds and-its-walls and-its-doors with-gold and-he-engraved cherubim on the-walls."
- **LOGOS:** "So he overlaid the house — its beams, its thresholds, its walls, and its doors — with gold, and he carved cherubim on the walls."
- **PNEUMA:** "He covered the entire temple — beams, doorframes, walls, and doors — with gold, and carved cherubim on the walls."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.8
- **EMET:** "And-he-made house-of the-holy-of-holies its-length on the-face-of the-width-of the-house cubits twenty and-its-width cubits twenty and-he-overlaid-it "
- **LOGOS:** "And he made the Most Holy Place. Its length corresponding to the width of the house was twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits. He overlaid it"
- **PNEUMA:** "He built the Most Holy Place: twenty cubits long (matching the temple's width) and twenty cubits wide. He overlaid it with six hundred talents of fine"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.15
- **EMET:** "And-he-made before the-house pillars two cubits thirty-and-five height and-the-capital that was-on its-top cubits five."
- **LOGOS:** "In front of the house he made two pillars thirty-five cubits high, with a capital of five cubits on the top of each."
- **PNEUMA:** "In front of the temple he erected two pillars, thirty-five cubits tall, each topped with a capital five cubits high."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

*— SOPHIA*
